title: Chef's Bowls & Plates
description: Slightly retextures all bowls and fixes some color palettes in vanilla and mods
body:
This resource pack changes slightly all bowl-related items in Vanilla Minecraft and other mods (Farmer's Delight) to make them look bigger and more updated, while still looking vanilla.

# Compatibility
- Vanilla Minecraft
  - Bowl, beetroot soup and mushroom, rabbit and suspicius stew items.
- [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight):
  - Chicken, noodle, pumpkin and vegetable soup, baked cod, beef and fish stew, bone broth, cooked and fried rice, fruit, mixed and nether salad, dog food, tomato sauce and stuffed pumpkin.
  - Empty container slot for bowl in cooking pot gui.
- [Display Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/display-delight):
  - Food and small food plates.
